errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis has ticks at specific values (0.2, 0.4, etc.). The axis actually represents categorical ranges: 0~0.2, 0.2~0.4, 0.4~0.6, 0.6~0.8, and 0.8~1.0.
The description fails to mention that each bar is explicitly annotated with its exact numerical value (0, 8, 16, 35, 37) on top of the bar. The prompt requires noting any annotations.
